'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[2023 Nablus clashes]]
***Eleven [[Palestinians]] are killed and 102 more injured when [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli troops]] storm [[Nablus]], in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/2/22/israeli-forces-kill-palestinians-in-nablus-raid (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Ten people are killed when [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] gunmen storm a house in [[Mogadishu]] where several lawmakers are staying. All four attackers are killed by [[Somali National Army|soldiers]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-shabaab-attack-kills-10-officials-house-somalia-ministry-2023-02-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**At least 15 soldiers are killed during an [[ambush]] in [[Tin-Akoff Department]], [[Oudalan Province]]. Several of the attackers are killed in the ensuing gunfight. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/africa/at-least-70-burkina-faso-troops-killed-in-twin-terrorist-attacks/amp (Daily Sabah)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least five people are killed and 48 others are reported missing following a [[mining accident|collapse]] at a [[Coal mining|coal mine]] in [[Alxa League]], [[Inner Mongolia]], [[China]]. [[Search and rescue]] operations are underway. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/two-killed-more-than-50-trapped-china-coal-mine-collapse-state-media-2023-02-22/ (Reuters)]

[https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-cancels-decree-underpinning-moldovas-sovereignty-separatist-conflict-2023-02-22/ (Reuters)]

**[[Germany]] expels two employees of the [[Iran]]ian [[embassy]] in response to Iran [[sentence (law)|sentencing]] pro-[[monarchist]] dual German-Iranian [[Jamshid Sharmahd]] to death over a [[Shiraz bombing|2008 bombing]] in Iran.
